targetCompanyImage.name: Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform
targetCompanyImage.description: The Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform is a U.S. portfolio of carrier-neutral data centers and interconnection facilities held through asset-level joint ventures and operated by FifteenFortySeven Critical Systems Realty. The partnership began with its September 3, 2020 acquisition of the Wells carrier hotel in Milwaukee and later expanded through properties including Midway Technology Centre (CHIL1), Pittock Block, AlohaNAP, DRFortress and facilities in Chicago, Orangeburg, Wyoming, Michigan, South Bend and McAllen. 1547 reports more than 1.25 million square feet under management. Harrison Street and 1547 are current co-owners, but exact platform stakes, the Harrison Street fund and any umbrella legal entity are not publicly disclosed. Corporate 1547 is the operator and sponsor rather than a company proven to be owned by Harrison Street, and the individual facilities are assets within the platform. Midway has been marketed for sale, but no buyer, signed transfer or closing was identified through August 19, 2026; no platform-level sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified.

milestones.event: Harrison Street and 1547 acquired Midway Technology Centre (CHIL1) from CIM Group as one facility in a four-asset portfolio transaction.
Harrison Street and 1547 completed their first joint acquisition, the Wells carrier hotel and data center in Milwaukee.
CIM Group sold Midway/CHIL1, CHIL2, ORNY1 and CHWY1 to the Harrison Street–1547 joint venture, expanding the partnership to six data centers while 1547 remained manager.
Harrison Street and 1547 added AlohaNAP to their joint national connectivity platform, which then exceeded one million square feet.
Harrison Street and 1547 announced full occupancy and a further expansion at the Orangeburg data center, confirming continuing joint platform activity.
